summary_en: This study is testing epcoritamab in adults with follicular lymphoma and marginal zone lymphoma who did not reach a complete response after first-line (upfront) therapy. Epcoritamab is given as a subcutaneous injection under the skin, in 28-day cycles, for up to 12 cycles, with the dosing days changing across cycles as set by the protocol. The record does not state the main outcome measure; the study is Phase 2.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa epcoritamab en adultos con linfoma folicular y linfoma de zona marginal que no lograron una respuesta completa después del tratamiento inicial (de primera línea). El epcoritamab se administra como inyección subcutánea, debajo de la piel, en ciclos de 28 días, por hasta 12 ciclos, con días de dosis que cambian entre ciclos según el protocolo. El registro no indica la medida principal de resultado; el estudio es de Fase 2.
who_for: Biopsy-confirmed follicular lymphoma, grade 1 to 3A, that is CD20 positive.
Stage III or IV at first diagnosis, with measurable disease on baseline PET/CT.
Received at least 3 cycles of first-line anti-CD20 antibody plus chemotherapy, with partial response or stable disease as best response.
Age 18 or older, ECOG performance status 2 or lower, and life expectancy over 2 years.
Adequate blood counts, liver, kidney and bone marrow function, and completed prior therapy at least 28 days before starting.
not_for: Known or suspected brain or spinal fluid (CNS or leptomeningeal) involvement.
Uncontrolled active infection needing hospital care or intravenous antibiotics within 4 weeks.
Uncontrolled heart or neurologic conditions, or ejection fraction below 45%.
Pregnant or breastfeeding, HIV, or unwilling to use highly effective contraception.
